queue.question: Which current UE 5.8, SideFX Karma, and modern atmosphere/whole-atmosphere ideas are transferable into KAOPU as vendor-independent atmosphere/lighting semantics and evaluator contracts without copying engine implementations or defaults?
queue.progress: R01 separated atmosphere truth/state from evaluator policy using current UE 5.8, SideFX Karma, Hillaire 2020, Bruneton 2017, and Wilkie et al. 2021. R02 extended the candidate from lower-atmosphere rendering to continuous ground-to-space semantics using NASA layer references, current NASA CCMC NRLMSIS whole-atmosphere references, thermosphere/ionosphere model boundaries, and HITRAN-backed spectral semantics. R03 added executable evaluator evidence: one synthetic unit-explicit AtmosphereState was queried by spherical-reference and plane-parallel evaluators. The plane-parallel approximation was nearly exact for a vertical ground query but reached ~96% relative transmittance error at 89-degree view zenith, proving that evaluator authority must carry a measured validity envelope. The Karman line, physical-state validity domain, and evaluator integration domain remain distinct.
queue.nextGate: Create a tiny Earth multi-altitude AtmosphereState fixture spanning ground, stratosphere, mesosphere, ~100 km, thermosphere, and exosphere reference points using two independent roots: U.S. Standard Atmosphere 1976 as a static regression reference and NRLMSIS 2.1 as a time/location/space-weather-dependent reference. Add a wavelength-limited optical checkpoint set with explicit spectroscopy provenance. Promotion requires explicit valid domains, coordinate/unit identity, provenance, evaluator error budgets, and Unknown handling—not visual similarity.

queue.question: Which modern procedural noise and field-composition methods are measurably better than current KAOPU typed-wave primitives for multiscale natural structure?
queue.progress: R01 primary-source review across Unreal Engine 5.8, current SideFX Houdini documentation, Blender 5.2 LTS, Pixar Wavelet Noise, and NVIDIA 2023 found no universal superior noise basis.
